title: Replace libpgs with libbitsub and adds support for vobsub rendering

target.summary: Using track?.DeliveryUrl as a candidate filename hint causes embedded VobSub streams to extract a filename ending in .vobsub, making libbitsub treat them as an .idx/.sub pair instead of falling back to subtitle.mks and failing to render.
notes: faulty statement including DeliveryUrl as candidate filename hint
call site passing the faulty filename hint to VobSub renderer options
